hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-light tracking-tighter text-white
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-medium tracking-tight text-white
hierarchy.code: text-sm font-mono text-blue-400 bg-gray-900/50 p-4 rounded-md border border-gray-800

visual_enhancers.grain: Apply a subtle SVG noise filter overlay across the main app background to achieve 'Cyberpunk-Institutional Grain'. Blend mode: overlay, opacity: 2-5%.
visual_enhancers.tracing_beam: For active or selected cards/panels, use a 1px border that animates or glows with Amber (#f59e0b) to signify activity.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: For sticky headers and floating navs, use backdrop-blur-xl with a highly saturated dark background (bg-[#090d16]/60) and a 1px bottom border of border-white/10.
visual_enhancers.glows: Subtle box-shadow glows (blur 16px to 32px) behind critical Amber/Electric-Blue icons or status indicators. Do not overuse.

layouts.general: Left-aligned dominant structure. Do not center-align the main application flow. Use asymmetrical grids (e.g., col-span-8 for content, col-span-4 for metadata).
layouts.concept_paper_portal: Wide asymmetrical layout. Main content area uses massive whitespace (p-12 to p-24) with IBM Plex Serif. Sidebar for Chapter Navigation (MDX) and Bookmarks uses Inter. Left-aligned typography.
layouts.compliance_cockpit: High-density Bento Grid layout (tight gap-4). Data-heavy tables and densely packed info-panels. No excessive whitespace here.
layouts.reference_sandbox: Split-pane layout. Left: Interactive form/settings. Right: Code/CBOR Viewer in JetBrains Mono.

components.buttons: Sharp edges or extremely slight radius (rounded-sm). Dark background with electric-blue or amber 1px borders. High contrast on hover (e.g., hover:bg-amber-500 hover:text-black).
components.cards: Flat, dark surfaces. No heavy drop-shadows. Rely on 1px inner borders (border-white/5). Hover state: slightly lifts with an amber or blue tracing beam border.
components.tables: Dense rows, left-aligned text. Use JetBrains Mono for cryptographic hashes (SHA-256) and logs. Distinct visual states for LoA levels (Low/Substantial/High).
components.navigation: Sticky left sidebar or top-nav with active chapter highlighting. Bookmarks use subtle amber indicators.
components.diagrams: Mermaid.js rendered in Dark Theme. Custom SVG map for Country Federation with glowing nodes for member states.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text against #090d16 meets at least AA standard (4.5:1). Amber (#f59e0b) must be used carefully against white text.
accessibility.focus: Focus states should use a 2px solid Electric-Blue (#3b82f6) outline with a 2px offset.
accessibility.test_ids: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute formatted as kebab-case-role (e.g., data-testid='verify-sd-jwt-button').

image_urls.description: Abstract blue and white tech network art for main landing page. Fits the EU-Sternenkranz tech motif.
Glowing brain/node inside a geometric structure representing AI Act / GDPR Compliance Shield.
Purple and blue fiber optic data pipeline representing X.509 chains and LOTL parsers.
Close up of a blue and black globe representing the Multi-Country Federation Map.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Shadcn/UI for components, but strip excessive drop shadows and rounded corners. Keep it sharp and institutional.
Do not use generic centering. Keep layouts left-aligned, establishing an academic, paper-like reading flow.
Integrate lucide-react icons exclusively. NO EMOJIS.
Set up primary routing for: Landing, Concept Paper Portal, Reference Sandbox, Compliance Cockpit, Developer Hub, Trust-Pipeline Viewer.
Implement a subtle grain overlay using an SVG filter or pure CSS noise.
Implement Mermaid.js with its dark theme configuration for architectural diagrams.
Ensure all fonts are loaded correctly (Inter, IBM Plex Serif, JetBrains Mono) and applied globally to the respective semantic tags.
Ensure robust data-testid coverage for all buttons, toggles, and form inputs.
Use ONLY .jsx/.js files for React components, aligning with standard JavaScript implementation rather than TypeScript.
NEVER use fully transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, sticky headers, or modals. Always use #090d16 with high opacity or backdrop-blur.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not apply `transition: all` to avoid breaking specific transforms.
Do not center-align the main app container (.App { text-align: center; } is strictly forbidden).
Build custom components matching existing Shadcn/UI patterns.
Use 'sonner' for toast notifications, configured to match the dark cyberpunk aesthetic.
Add micro-animations on all interactive elements (hover, focus, active states).
Do NOT use placeholder image URLs. Use the provided Unsplash URLs.
